# command queue overflow 정책 fixture v1 (XII.1.2)
#
# 문법
#   case <이름>                               새 case 시작
#   capacity <input> <command> <background>   lane별 용량으로 빈 queue 생성
#   push <label> <spec> [coalesce=<key>] => <기대>
#     spec : input | command | background
#            input:pointer-move:<device> | input:resize | input:wheel | input:discrete
#     key  : pointer-move:<device> | resize | custom:<n>
#     기대 : enqueued | coalesced <대체된 label> | evicted <밀려난 label> | full | closed
#   close                                     새 접수 닫기
#   drain => <label...> | -                   try_pop으로 모두 꺼낸 순서
#   end                                       case 끝(대기 항목이 없어야 함)

case priority_order_input_command_background
capacity 4 4 4
push b1 background => enqueued
push c1 command => enqueued
push i1 input => enqueued
push b2 background => enqueued
push c2 command => enqueued
push i2 input:discrete => enqueued
drain => i1 i2 c1 c2 b1 b2
end

case input_full_rejects_without_dropping
capacity 2 2 2
push i1 input:discrete => enqueued
push i2 input:wheel => enqueued
push i3 input:discrete => full
push i4 input:pointer-move:1 => full
drain => i1 i2
push i5 input:discrete => enqueued
drain => i5
end

case command_full_rejects_without_dropping
capacity 2 1 2
push c1 command => enqueued
push c2 command => full
push i1 input => enqueued
drain => i1 c1
end

case background_full_evicts_oldest
capacity 2 2 2
push b1 background => enqueued
push b2 background => enqueued
push b3 background => evicted b1
push b4 background => evicted b2
drain => b3 b4
end

case lanes_are_independent
capacity 1 1 1
push b1 background => enqueued
push b2 background => evicted b1
push c1 command => enqueued
push i1 input => enqueued
push c2 command => full
push i2 input => full
drain => i1 c1 b2
end

case pointer_move_coalesces_only_adjacent_same_device
capacity 8 8 8
push m1 input:pointer-move:1 => enqueued
push m2 input:pointer-move:1 => coalesced m1
push m3 input:pointer-move:1 => coalesced m2
push k1 input:discrete => enqueued
push m4 input:pointer-move:1 => enqueued
push p1 input:pointer-move:2 => enqueued
push p2 input:pointer-move:2 => coalesced p1
push m5 input:pointer-move:1 => enqueued
drain => m3 k1 m4 p2 m5
end

case coalesce_needs_no_capacity
capacity 2 1 1
push k1 input:discrete => enqueued
push m1 input:pointer-move:1 => enqueued
push m2 input:pointer-move:1 => coalesced m1
push k2 input:discrete => full
push m3 input:pointer-move:1 => coalesced m2
drain => k1 m3
end

case resize_coalesces_wheel_does_not
capacity 8 8 8
push r1 input:resize => enqueued
push r2 input:resize => coalesced r1
push w1 input:wheel => enqueued
push w2 input:wheel => enqueued
push r3 input:resize => enqueued
drain => r2 w1 w2 r3
end

case coalesce_is_per_lane
capacity 4 4 4
push i1 input coalesce=custom:7 => enqueued
push c1 command coalesce=custom:7 => enqueued
push c2 command coalesce=custom:7 => coalesced c1
push i2 input coalesce=custom:7 => coalesced i1
drain => i2 c2
end

case background_coalesce_before_evict
capacity 1 1 1
push b1 background coalesce=custom:1 => enqueued
push b2 background coalesce=custom:1 => coalesced b1
push b3 background coalesce=custom:2 => evicted b2
drain => b3
end

case closed_rejects_new_and_drains_pending
capacity 2 2 2
push i1 input => enqueued
push c1 command => enqueued
push b1 background => enqueued
close
push i2 input => closed
push b2 background => closed
drain => i1 c1 b1
end

case closed_rejects_coalesce_candidate
capacity 2 2 2
push m1 input:pointer-move:1 => enqueued
close
push m2 input:pointer-move:1 => closed
drain => m1
drain => -
end
